name: What to do if your water bill jumps unexpectedly

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Finding a significantly higher water bill in your mailbox can be a real headache, but there are some clear steps you can take to figure out what's going on. First, check all your visible faucets, showerheads, and outdoor spigots for any drips. Even a slow drip can add up quickly. Next, listen closely around your toilets; often, a faulty flapper or fill valve can cause them to run continuously, wasting a lot of water. You can even try adding a few drops of food coloring to your toilet tank – if the color appears in the bowl without flushing, you've got a leak. If these simple checks don't reveal an obvious problem, it's wise to consider deeper issues like a slab leak or an underground pipe problem. These require specialized detection equipment and expertise. Don't just ignore it and hope it goes away; unresolved leaks can lead to significant property damage over time.
